scripts.render: node compose.mjs && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render composition --output out/demo-final.mp4
scripts.render:draft: node compose.mjs && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render composition --quality draft --output out/demo-draft.mp4
scripts.render:x: CUT=x node compose.mjs && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render composition --composition cut-x.html --output out/demo-x-2min.mp4
scripts.all: npm run capture && npm run render
scripts.render:nomusic: MUSIC=0 node compose.mjs && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render composition --output out/demo-final-nomusic.mp4
